subject: Open-source GitHub connector — demo request and scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@openforge.dev>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Open-source GitHub connector — demo request

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

We signed up on your self-serve flow and are evaluating Redwood for a GitHub connector that can run inference on public repos. A couple quick things before we book:
- Does the connector require admin-level webhook permissions for read-only analysis, or can it work with a repo-scoped token?
- We’re curious about on-prem/private options later — do you support air-gapped deploys for open-source orgs?

We’d like a short demo next week to see the connector flow, webhook events, and how caching affects token usage. I’m in BST (UTC+1) and prefer morning slots (08:00–11:00 UTC). Attached is a small CSV with a few repo names we want to show.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
OpenForge – Dev Tools
attachments: openforge-repo-list.csv (text/csv)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Alex Morgan <alex@openforge.dev>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Open-source GitHub connector — demo request

Hi Alex — thanks for signing up and sending the repo list. Quick answers up front:
- The initial connector works with repo-scoped tokens for read operations; admin/webhook perms are optional when you use our webhook relay helper. We can walk through both in the demo.
- We do offer private/on-prem options (Redwood Private) — we’ll share a short compliance brief in the pre-call materials.

Suggested times (UTC):
- Tue 2026-04-14 09:00–09:30 UTC
- Tue 2026-04-14 10:30–11:00 UTC
- Wed 2026-04-15 08:00–08:30 UTC

If any of those work, I’ll send a calendar invite. If you prefer, you can pick a slot directly: https://calendly.com/redwood/karthik-30m?hidden_event=repo-integration

Also looping in Marissa from pre-sales for the intake and Mateo for a short technical deep-dive if we need to dig into webhook scopes.

—Karthik Iy er
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Morgan <alex@openforge.dev>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Open-source GitHub connector — demo request

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the quick reply.
A few follow-ups before we lock a slot:
1) Right now we want to avoid granting admin to our org. Can you demo the webhook relay helper and confirm the event delivery guarantees (at-least-once vs at-most-once)?
2) Token handling: do you store tokens on your hosted offering or is it possible to bring-your-own-KMS?

If those can be covered in the first 20 minutes, Tue 2026-04-14 09:00 UTC works for me.

Also, can we shift to 09:30 UTC if the engineering team needs an extra 30 minutes to prep?
